response_text:
15 (Currently amended) A method for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, wherein the information is provided by a media request broker in response to a media request from the client computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier, wherein the unique signature is distinct from and separate from any URL or standard resource locator; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator, wherein the selection is performed by the media request broker based on server load, availability, or geographic proximity.

16 (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including a unique signature __distinct from a standard URL__, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature __transmitted to the media request broker__ identifying a media request, __wherein the media request broker processes the unique signature to determine server selection criteria__.

17 (Original)

18 (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __and the unique signature contained in the http request, wherein the selection criteria include at least one of server load balancing, geographic location, or content availability__.
